subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
unit: Unit 4: I want to be a doctor!
outcomes: I can say the long ea in read and the short ea in bread.
I can sort ea words into two groups.
I can read and write the tricky word want.

tf.s: The ea in beach is long, like in read.
tf.why: Yes! beach and read have the long ea.

tf.s: The ea in bread is long, like in sea.
tf.why: The ea in bread is short, like in head.

tf.s: head and feather have the same ea sound.
tf.why: Right! Both have the short ea.

tf.s: leaf and weather have the same ea sound.
tf.why: leaf has a long ea. weather has a short ea.

tf.s: sea has the long ea sound.
tf.why: Well done! sea has the long ea.

tf.s: The letters ea can make two different sounds.
tf.why: Yes! ea can be long or short.

tf.s: We say: She want a kite.
We say: I want to go to the beach.
tf.why: Great! I want to … is correct.

tf.s: We spell the tricky word want: w-o-n-t.
The word read and the word bread have the same ea sound.
tf.why: read has a long ea. bread has a short ea.

boxes.q: Is the ea in beach long or short?
Is the ea in bread long or short?
Which word has the same ea sound as head?
boxes.why: head and bread have a short ea.

boxes.q: Which word has the same ea sound as read?
boxes.why: read and leaf have a long ea.

boxes.q: Complete: I ___ to make some bread.
Complete: She ___ a kite, some bread and a leaf.
Complete: I want to ___ a leaf.
boxes.why: After want to, we use see.

boxes.q: What do you want to do?
o: I want to go to the beach.
I wants to go to the beach.
I want go to the beach.
boxes.why: We say: I want to go …

boxes.q: Which word is the tricky word?
boxes.why: want is the tricky word in this lesson.

mcq.q: Which word has a short ea?
Which word has a long ea?
Which is the Unit 4 tongue twister?
o: I eat bread and read on the beach in the hot weather.
I eat beach and read on the bread in the hot weather.
I read bread and eat on the beach in the cold weather.
I eat bread and read in the sea in the hot weather.
mcq.why: Well done! That is the tongue twister.

mcq.q: How do you spell the tricky word?
Sort: leaf, feather, sea, head. Which words have the long ea?
mcq.why: leaf and sea have a long ea.

mcq.q: Complete: He wants a cake, a phone and ___.
Answer: What do you want to do?
o: I want to see the sea.
I wants to see the sea.
I want to sees the sea.
mcq.why: We say: I want to see the sea.

mcq.q: Why do read and bread look the same but sound different?
o: ea can make a long or a short sound.
mcq.why: The letters ea have two sounds.

mcq.q: Which group is all short ea?
mcq.why: bread, head and feather all have a short ea.

o: I want to see the sea.
